Instrumenting the Stack: Strategies for End-to-end Sanitizer Adoption - Damien Buhl - CppCon 2025
---

Sanitizers like UBSanitizer, MemorySanitizer, AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, and Clang’s Thread Safety Analysis are powerful tools for making C++ code safer, but their effectiveness hinges on full-stack instrumentation and proper debug info, even in optimized builds.

Migrating to such setups is rarely straightforward, especially when dealing with prebuilt libraries or diverse build systems like CMake, Bazel, GN, or Autotools.

In this talk, we’ll walk through practical approaches for enabling sanitizers across complex codebases. We’ll share CMake modules that facilitate transitioning to full-source builds, explore workarounds for closed-source dependencies, and discuss techniques like debug fission to manage symbol bloat from modern C++ metaprogramming.
